home.experience: I have a degree in Graphic Design since 2011, with over a decade of experience in visual creation and 3D modeling. I have technical proficiency in Maya, ZBrush, Photoshop, KeyShot, and Substance 3D Painter, which I use to turn ideas into impactful visuals for product design, animation, architectural visualization, or motion design projects.
home.techSkills: Besides design, I am passionate about technology and programming, focusing on React JS and Python. This combination allows me to integrate art and logic, creating interactive and functional visual solutions.
home.goals: I am seeking opportunities in 3D design, tech art, digital visualization, and projects that value creativity, technical skill, and innovation. Let's connect!

resume.title: Resume
resume.professionalSummary: I am a graphic designer graduated from Universidade Paulista (UNIP) in 2011, with solid experience in 3D modeling, animation, and visual design. I started my career at Lubrin Engineering, working on 3D projects of engines, reducers, and technical components, in addition to developing graphic materials such as flyers and brochures, managing the company website, and editing images and videos. After that, I worked as a freelancer at IzotonicStudios, contributing to 3D modeling, texturing, and 2D/3D animation for characters and environments. Simultaneously, I work as a designer at MentalPlus®, responsible for the homonymous neuropsychology app. There, I model and animate the mascot Dr. Brainy and maintain the company's website. I am passionate about technology and innovation, always seeking to stay updated with new tools and techniques. I have a collaborative, proactive, goal-oriented, determined, and highly detail-oriented creative approach.
